implementation.entry_points: Desktop message menus and mobile long-press sheets open the existing moderation report dialog for messages not authored by the current user.
implementation.authorization: The service loads the source through the existing channel or DM around-message service, thereby enforcing channel read permission or DM participation, then verifies that the reported user authored the source message.
implementation.persistence: Migration 106 and the report repository persist source kind, server, channel and message IDs plus the optional evidence snapshot; duplicate pending checks are message-specific.
implementation.e2ee_consent: Decrypted message text is omitted by default. The client sends it only after a separate explicit checkbox and the server rejects evidence_content without evidence_consent.
